text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! The Derby!
I'm the one who's gonna win itttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She still has this much power left in her legs... But still!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Like I'm gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Hayahide & Taishin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And the leader crosses the finish line!
The champion of the Japanese Derby is—"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... Royce lost...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, the Derby really is
a long way off, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Right. Well, from my perspective, just being able to participate is amazing on its own...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*...!
I guess it's never that easy, huh...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Still, with how much I managed to do,
I should get plenty of attention!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, the real appeal starts from here.
A heartbroken Royce-chan will tug right at their heartstrings!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAGH!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it over...? Is this really the end?
The Derby... My Derby...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to win, I wanted to win, I wanted to win!!
Waaaahhhhh, waaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
————
...Don't cry, dummy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right... *sniff*
I'll be sure to properly congratulate you on your victory...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
C-Congrat... *sniff*
Uuu, hic, waaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Your face is a complete mess.
Come on, let's go back and grab a towel.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket, this isn't the end.
We still have the autumn season. Right?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Taishin... Hayahideee...
*waaaaahhhhh*!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"‘Ticket-zo...’ ‘Ticket-zo...!’
‘Ugh..., Ticket-zo!!’"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"‘Ticket-zo!! Autumn... there's still autumn!’
‘I'm going to watch the Kikuka Sho! I'll definitely be there cheering for you!’"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "WOOOAAAAAH!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if giving voice to her bitter disappointment,
the crowd's cries tore through the sky.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A loss is a loss.
Even though we both lost, I can't believe how differently
Ticket-san and I are being treated by the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: So I lost in terms of drama, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Her goal of being the "strongest" means becoming an Umamusume who will remain in people's memories and be talked about for generations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who captured the hearts of the spectators
and left the deepest impression in today's Japanese Derby was—

text_block_list.name: Sports Newspaper Article
text_block_list.text:
"‘Dreams shattered... Winning Ticket weeps uncontrollably!
Though she fought alongside Hayahide and Taishin, it ends in bitter regret.
Overcoming this hardship with her friends, she heads towards autumn—’"

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
"‘The Derby, BNW's friendship made me cry.’
‘I'm worried about Ticket-zo's mental state...’
‘BNW's showdown still has the Kikuka Sho!’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"BNW is an acronym referring to Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin,
and Winning Ticket.
Lately, that nickname is beginning to take root."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And the public response to the Japanese Derby was overwhelmingly focused on the BNW trio."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I suppose it was bound to turn out this way.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even though I set everything up, right down to the
drama of her setback at the Satsuki Sho, as part of my production..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If this still loses out on impact,
what am I supposed to do?! I'm totally out of options!
choice_data_list: Let's think about it together! There has to be a way!
Let's think about it together! There's got to be a way!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She threw herself into her training with great fervor,
while also rushing around handling her self-production.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She puts in twice the effort of other Umamusume.
I want to give her results that truly match that dedication.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Isn't there anything?
Some way to make the existence of Rice Shower stand out even more...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for giving up so easily.
Thinking—that's it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"My weapon is this brain of mine.
Thinking, thinking, and thinking everything through."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I'll find a path to becoming the "strongest"...!
choice_data_list: I'll think of a way too!
I'll think of a way too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes... If the two of you compare your ideas,
it might lead to new realizations.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Let's reset and refocus!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Actually, the reason we lost in terms of impact is quite clear.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san's interview. She talked about how, before the Derby,
she was feeling down until Hayahide-san and
Taishin-san cheered her up, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: And from there, the conversation broadened to how we've pushed each other as friends and rivals ever since we first enrolled.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it even made it into an online news article.
Yeah, it even made the online news.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That drama about friendship delivered the final blow.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Friendship with a rival—now that's true youth!
The classic sports anime trope! No wonder she's so strong!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haaah... BNW already has the ability, and now they've got youth drama on top of it...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A simple touching drama about a hardworking Umamusume
isn't going to be enough to win on its own.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, the teen drama is just too strong.
You won't easily find anything that can beat it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "As long as they hold the ultimate trump card known as 'youth,' we have no chance of winning."
choice_data_list: ...Hm? But is it really necessary to win?
...Hm? But do you really have to win?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The goal is to create a drama that captivates hearts.
Wouldn't it be fine to play our strongest card together
and leave a lasting impression?
choice_data_list: In other words, living out our youth with BNW!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ! Indeed...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No, but still... Is there really a need to cling
to youth to the point of recycling running gags—
choice_data_list: It does! Youth hits adults right in the heart!
It does! Youth hits adults right in the heart!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: An adult? Why?
choice_data_list: Because you can relive the experience!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The unique brilliance of youth that one only realizes as an adult.
After-school hours spent with friends,
and training camps that were both tough and fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The daily life we took for granted back then looks so bright and sparkling once you become an adult.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By watching teen drama shows, adults can relive memories
and vicariously experience the youth
they never had.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Is that so?
I see, I see... Speaking from personal experience?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So its effectiveness is already proven!
That's wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I don't have an adult's perspective,
so that's super helpful!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Keep those kinds of opinions
coming non-stop from now on!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright, change of plans!
From now on, we're going with a refreshing, hot-blooded youth sports vibe!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And conveniently enough,
we have summer training camp coming up—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: It also doubles as a chance to gather intel for the next Kikuka Sho—two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now, time to restart
my self-producing!!
